+---
+module: netapp_e_drive_firmware
+short_description: Manage NetApp E-Series drive firmware
+description:
+  - Upload drive firmware and upgrade compatible drives that are not already at the supplied version.
+version_added: '2.10'
+author: NetApp
+extends_documentation_fragment:
+  - netapp.eseries
+options:
+  firmware:
+    description: Local paths to NetApp E-Series drive firmware files.
+    type: list
+    elements: path
+    required: true
+  wait_for_completion:
+    description: Wait until all selected drives finish upgrading.
+    type: bool
+    default: no
+  ignore_inaccessible_drives:
+    description: Skip offline or unavailable drives instead of failing.
+    type: bool
+    default: no
+  upgrade_drives_online:
+    description: Upgrade drives while they continue to accept I/O.
+    type: bool
+    default: yes
+notes:
+  - Check mode uploads the firmware so the controller can report compatibility, but does not initiate an upgrade.
+'''
+
+EXAMPLES = '''
+- name: Upgrade compatible drives
+  netapp_e_drive_firmware:

+    ssid: '1'
+    firmware:
+      - /tmp/drive_firmware.dlp
+    wait_for_completion: yes
+'''
+

+import os

+

+from units.compat import mock
+from units.modules.utils import AnsibleExitJson, AnsibleFailJson, ModuleTestCase, set_module_args
+
+
+class DriveFirmwareTest(ModuleTestCase):
+    def make_module(self, **options):
+        args = dict(api_url='https://array/devmgr/v2', api_username='admin', api_password='secret',
+                    ssid='1', firmware=['/tmp/new.dlp'])
+        args.update(options)
+        set_module_args(args)
+        return NetAppESeriesDriveFirmware()
+
+    def test_upgrade_list_filters_and_caches(self):
+        firmware = self.make_module()
+        compatibility = [
+            dict(filename='new.dlp', targetVersion='NEW', compatibleDrives=[
+                dict(driveRef='needs', onlineUpgradeCapable=True),
+                dict(driveRef='current', onlineUpgradeCapable=True)]),
+            dict(filename='other.dlp', targetVersion='NEW', compatibleDrives=[dict(driveRef='other')])]
+
+        def response(path, **kwargs):
+            if path == 'firmware/drives':
+                return 200, compatibility
+            return 200, dict(firmwareVersion='NEW' if path.endswith('current') else 'OLD',
+                             available=True, offline=False)
+
+        with mock.patch.object(firmware, '_request', side_effect=response) as request_mock:
+            expected = [dict(filename='new.dlp', driveRefList=['needs'])]
+            self.assertEqual(firmware.upgrade_list(), expected)
+            self.assertEqual(firmware.upgrade_list(), expected)
+            self.assertEqual(request_mock.call_count, 3)
+
+    def test_apply_check_mode_reports_change_without_upgrade(self):
+        firmware = self.make_module(_ansible_check_mode=True)
+        with mock.patch.object(firmware, 'upload_firmware') as upload, \
+                mock.patch.object(firmware, 'upgrade_list', return_value=[dict(filename='new.dlp', driveRefList=['one'])]), \
+                mock.patch.object(firmware, 'upgrade') as upgrade:
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleExitJson) as result:
+                firmware.apply()
+        self.assertTrue(result.exception.args[0]['changed'])
+        self.assertFalse(result.exception.args[0]['upgrade_in_process'])
+        upload.assert_called_once_with()
+        upgrade.assert_not_called()
+
+    def test_wait_only_checks_selected_drives(self):
+        firmware = self.make_module()
+        firmware._upgrade_list = [dict(filename='new.dlp', driveRefList=['one'])]
+        firmware.upgrade_in_progress = True
+        with mock.patch.object(firmware, '_request', return_value=(200, [
+                dict(driveRef='unrelated', status='failed'), dict(driveRef='one', status='okay')])):
+            firmware.wait_for_upgrade_completion()
+        self.assertFalse(firmware.upgrade_in_progress)
+

+        firmware = self.make_module()
+        with mock.patch.object(firmware, '_request', side_effect=[
+                (200, [dict(filename='new.dlp', targetVersion='NEW',
+                            compatibleDrives=[dict(driveRef='one', onlineUpgradeCapable=False)])]),
+                (200, dict(firmwareVersion='OLD', available=True))]):
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson) as result:

+        firmware = self.make_module(upgrade_drives_online=False)
+        firmware._upgrade_list = [dict(filename='new.dlp', driveRefList=['one'])]
+        with mock.patch.object(firmware, '_request', return_value=(202, {})) as request_mock:
+            firmware.upgrade()
+        self.assertTrue(firmware.upgrade_in_progress)
+        args, kwargs = request_mock.call_args
+        self.assertEqual(args[0], 'firmware/drives/initiate-upgrade')
+        self.assertFalse(json.loads(kwargs['data'])['onlineUpgrade'])
+
+    def test_upload_failure_identifies_file_and_array(self):
+        firmware = self.make_module()
+        with mock.patch('ansible.modules.storage.netapp.netapp_e_drive_firmware.create_multipart_formdata',
+                        side_effect=OSError('missing')):
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson) as result:
+                firmware.upload_firmware()
+        self.assertIn('Failed to upload drive firmware', result.exception.args[0]['msg'])
+        self.assertIn('/tmp/new.dlp', result.exception.args[0]['msg'])
+        self.assertIn('array 1', result.exception.args[0]['msg'])

+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+
+import json
+
+from ansible.modules.storage.netapp.netapp_e_drive_firmware import NetAppESeriesDriveFirmware
+from units.compat import mock
+from units.modules.utils import AnsibleExitJson, AnsibleFailJson, ModuleTestCase, set_module_args
+
+
+class DriveFirmwareTest(ModuleTestCase):
+    def make_module(self, **options):
+        args = dict(api_url='https://array/devmgr/v2', api_username='admin', api_password='secret',
+                    ssid='1', firmware=['/tmp/new.dlp'])
+        args.update(options)
+        set_module_args(args)
+        return NetAppESeriesDriveFirmware()
+
+    def test_upgrade_list_filters_and_caches(self):
+        firmware = self.make_module()
+        compatibility = [
+            dict(filename='new.dlp', targetVersion='NEW', compatibleDrives=[
+                dict(driveRef='needs', onlineUpgradeCapable=True),
+                dict(driveRef='current', onlineUpgradeCapable=True)]),
+            dict(filename='other.dlp', targetVersion='NEW', compatibleDrives=[dict(driveRef='other')])]
+
+        def response(path, **kwargs):
+            if path == 'firmware/drives':
+                return 200, compatibility
+            return 200, dict(firmwareVersion='NEW' if path.endswith('current') else 'OLD',
+                             available=True, offline=False)
+
+        with mock.patch.object(firmware, '_request', side_effect=response) as request_mock:
+            expected = [dict(filename='new.dlp', driveRefList=['needs'])]
+            self.assertEqual(firmware.upgrade_list(), expected)
+            self.assertEqual(firmware.upgrade_list(), expected)
+            self.assertEqual(request_mock.call_count, 3)
+
+    def test_apply_check_mode_reports_change_without_upgrade(self):
+        firmware = self.make_module(_ansible_check_mode=True)
+        with mock.patch.object(firmware, 'upload_firmware') as upload, \
+                mock.patch.object(firmware, 'upgrade_list', return_value=[dict(filename='new.dlp', driveRefList=['one'])]), \
+                mock.patch.object(firmware, 'upgrade') as upgrade:
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleExitJson) as result:
+                firmware.apply()
+        self.assertTrue(result.exception.args[0]['changed'])
+        self.assertFalse(result.exception.args[0]['upgrade_in_process'])
+        upload.assert_called_once_with()
+        upgrade.assert_not_called()
+
+    def test_wait_only_checks_selected_drives(self):
+        firmware = self.make_module()
+        firmware._upgrade_list = [dict(filename='new.dlp', driveRefList=['one'])]
+        firmware.upgrade_in_progress = True
+        with mock.patch.object(firmware, '_request', return_value=(200, [
+                dict(driveRef='unrelated', status='failed'), dict(driveRef='one', status='okay')])):
+            firmware.wait_for_upgrade_completion()
+        self.assertFalse(firmware.upgrade_in_progress)
+
+    def test_online_incapable_drive_fails(self):
+        firmware = self.make_module()
+        with mock.patch.object(firmware, '_request', side_effect=[
+                (200, [dict(filename='new.dlp', targetVersion='NEW',
+                            compatibleDrives=[dict(driveRef='one', onlineUpgradeCapable=False)])]),
+                (200, dict(firmwareVersion='OLD', available=True))]):
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson) as result:
+                firmware.upgrade_list()
+        self.assertIn('Drive is not capable of online upgrade.', result.exception.args[0]['msg'])
+
+    def test_upgrade_uses_offline_flag_and_reports_progress(self):
+        firmware = self.make_module(upgrade_drives_online=False)
+        firmware._upgrade_list = [dict(filename='new.dlp', driveRefList=['one'])]
+        with mock.patch.object(firmware, '_request', return_value=(202, {})) as request_mock:
+            firmware.upgrade()
+        self.assertTrue(firmware.upgrade_in_progress)
+        args, kwargs = request_mock.call_args
+        self.assertEqual(args[0], 'firmware/drives/initiate-upgrade')
+        self.assertFalse(json.loads(kwargs['data'])['onlineUpgrade'])
+
+    def test_upload_failure_identifies_file_and_array(self):
+        firmware = self.make_module()
+        with mock.patch('ansible.modules.storage.netapp.netapp_e_drive_firmware.create_multipart_formdata',
+                        side_effect=OSError('missing')):
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson) as result:
+                firmware.upload_firmware()
+        self.assertIn('Failed to upload drive firmware', result.exception.args[0]['msg'])
+        self.assertIn('/tmp/new.dlp', result.exception.args[0]['msg'])
+        self.assertIn('array 1', result.exception.args[0]['msg'])
